rows.Kwic: 驀拈拄杖云：「龍袖拂開全體現，象王行處絕狐蹤。」

Override.AttributionNote: 密雲禪師語錄, fifteenth-day hall address. Miyun Yuanwu is the exact speaker: abruptly raising his staff, he says that when the dragon sleeve brushes open the whole body appears and where the elephant king walks fox tracks cease.

rows.Kwic: 聲前一句，人人本具，放過一著，落在第二，若不放過，打出骨髓。

Override.AttributionNote: 密雲禪師語錄, hall address requested by layman Dong. Miyun Yuanwu is the exact speaker: he says everyone originally possesses the phrase before sound, and contrasts letting one move pass with striking out the marrow.

rows.Kwic: 我舉起右腳，本師云：『驢腳？馬腳？』我舉起左腳，本師云：『馬腳？驢腳？』

Override.AttributionNote: 密雲禪師語錄, Miyun Yuanwu's autobiographical account of visiting his root teacher. Huanyou Zhengchuan is the exact speaker of both stored questions: when Miyun raises his right foot Huanyou asks 'donkey leg or horse leg?', and when he raises his left foot Huanyou reverses the order.
